name: Andrea C. James
desc: founder of Families for Justice as Healing, and of the National Council for Incarcerated and Formerly Incarcerated Women and Girls
summary: Andrea C. James is an American human rights activist and political candidate. A former attorney, she was disbarred and sentenced to two years' imprisonment in 2009. Since her release, James has called for reform of the criminal justice system, including the end of the incarceration of women.
